flagship_product.name: Atelier
flagship_product.description: Sovereign platform that forges document-grounded AI assistants from an organisation's own documents; each assistant answers from a controlled corpus and cites its sources.

company_presentation.target_clients: Regulated, document-intensive organisations — including professional-services firms (accounting, audit, legal), the public sector and finance — where confidentiality, traceability and reliability are decisive

project_management_methodology.model: Hybrid delivery model combining agile iterations (two-week sprints) with a phase-gate structure
project_management_methodology.phase_gate: Each phase ends with a formal review and a go/no-go
project_management_methodology.framing_focus_professional_services: For professional-services clients, the framing phase pays particular attention to confidentiality, to the firm's existing production tools, and to the seasonality of the workload
